about.heading: A good congress moves people forward
paragraphs: New insights, valuable conversations and connections that keep paying off long after.
At JCC we make sure everything is right. Programme, speakers, venue, registration, budget and everything in between. So you can focus on what really matters: the people and the content.

images.alt: The audience applauding in a full hall at SLAAP2025

clients: Society for Light, Rhythms, and Circadian Health (SLRCH)
Nederlandse Vereniging voor Mondziekten, Kaak- en Aangezichtschirurgie (NVMKA)

annick.heading: Bringing people
paragraphs: I’m Annick Goijarts and I’ve been working in the congress industry for more than twenty years. For years I worked at the Amsterdam Convention Board, part of I amsterdam. Then I looked for a very different view: as a KLM flight attendant, I flew all over the world.
But I never let go of congresses. Even between my intercontinental flights, I kept organising them. And there were more and more!
At some point it simply no longer fitted alongside my work in the air. Time for a choice. I chose congresses: today I focus entirely on JCC.
And that’s exactly what makes me happy: bringing people together, arranging everything down to the last detail and making sure a congress doesn’t just run smoothly, but really makes an impact.
annick.role: Annick Goijarts · JCC Congress Consultancy & Events

community.heading: The congress ends
community.lead: A congress brings people together. But why should that connection stop when it’s over? JCC helps associations and organisations keep the conversation going. With newsletters, social media and support for smaller meetings.
community.closing: That way, one congress becomes the start of something more.

band.intro: No two congresses are the same. Luckily.
band.text: A small symposium or a large international congress: every event needs its own approach. We think along, keep the lines short and make sure everything is well arranged. With an eye for both content and atmosphere.

social.title: Not on the agenda,
social.text: The best conversations don’t always happen in the congress hall. That’s why we also organise the programme around it. From relaxed drinks to a party people talk about for a long time.
